meta.title: Disclosure Unit Admits Year Typo & Pushes VRR to OIC; Notes GDPR Breach Routed to IM Team

content.subject: Re: Right of Access Request 1567/25 — Clarification
content.body: Admits 47230214305 was a typing error; corrects to 47240214305. States initial report 22/07/2024; second report 02/11/2024. Says VRR must be directed to OIC and that Dixon GDPR breach will be passed to Information Management.
